|                              | kon'len'qa            | genes                                                                                                                                                                                 | thing + continuing + organism                                           |
|                              | ksooksu               | do's, things one must do lest trouble follows, duties, responsibilities, obligations, expectations, chores, tasks, roles                                                              | absence + troublesome // modelled off of Japanese "nakya dame"          |
|                              | duun'ksu              | don'ts, things one must avoid lest trouble follows, crimes, sins                                                                                                                      | presence + troublesome                                                  |
|                              | honen                 | similar way, similar manner                                                                                                                                                           | way + same                                                              |
|                              | qame                  | human life, one's life                                                                                                                                                                | life + person                                                           |
|                              | thaaten               | function, role, job, duty, service, responsibility                                                                                                                                    | effect + use                                                            |
|                              | zathii-(en)           | *n.* impact, influence, effect<br><br>*v.* to affect (transitive)                                                                                                                     | force + causative                                                       |
|                              | zathaa-(en)           | *n.* reaction, response<br><br>*v.* to respond, to react (to smth)                                                                                                                    | force + resultant                                                       |
|                              | jazathaa-(en)         | *n.* reply, verbal response<br><br>*v.* to reply, to respond                                                                                                                          | speech + response                                                       |
|                              | zaki-(en/an)          | *n.* explosion<br><br>*v.* to explode<br><br>*adj.* explosive                                                                                                                         | force + breaking/destruction                                            |
|                              | chen'go-(en)          | *n.* becoming solid / becoming tangible, materialization                                                                                                                              | becoming + matter                                                       |
|                              | chen'he-(en)          | *n.* evaporation / becoming intangible, vanishing                                                                                                                                     | becoming + air                                                          |
|                              | chen'lu-(en)          | *n.* melting, liquidization                                                                                                                                                           | becoming + liquid                                                       |

|                         | dajumyu         | husband                              | man + marriage                 |
|                         | bujumyu         | wife                                 | woman + marriage               |
|                         | pyada           | son                                  | child + male                   |
|                         | pyabu           | daughter                             | child + daughter               |
|                         | memyu           | sibling, twin                        | person + blood-related         |
|                         | memyu-nen       | identical twin                       | sibling + same (genetics)      |
|                         | memyu-nen'zhin  | fraternal twin                       | sibling + similar (genetics)   |
|                         | damyu           | brother                              | man + blood-related            |
|                         | bumyu           | sister                               | woman + blood-related          |
|                         | myumun          | extended family (family of a parent) | family + parent                |
|                         | hodamun         | paternal side of a family            | side + father                  |
|                         | homu            | maternal side of a family            | side + mother                  |
|                         | damyumun        | uncle                                | brother + parent               |
|                         | bumyumun        | aunt                                 | sister + parent                |
|                         | pya-myumun      | nephew, niece                        | child + parent's family        |
|                         | pyada-myumun    | nephew                               | son + parent's family          |
|                         | pyabu-myumun    | niece                                | daughter + parent's family     |
|                         | memyu-pi-myumun | cousin                               | sibling + of + parent's family |
|                         | damyu-pi-myumun | male cousin                          | brother + of + parent's family |
|                         | bumyu-pi-myumun | female cousin                        | sister + of + parent's family  |
|                         | mun'zho         | grandparent                          | parent + elder                 |
|                         | mun'zhozho(...) | great (...) grandparent              | grandparent + elder            |
|                         | damun'zho       | grandfather                          | father + elder                 |
|                         | muzho           | grandmother                          | mother + elder                 |
## Roles

| glyph | sound       | meaning                                                                            | combo                    |
| ----- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
|       | mero        | monarch, sovereign, governer, ruler                                                | person + ruling          |
|       | daro        | king                                                                               | man + ruling             |
|       | buro        | queen                                                                              | woman + ruling           |
|       | pyaburo     | princess, royal daughter                                                           | daughter + ruling        |
|       | pyadaro     | prince, royal son                                                                  | son + ruling             |
|       | mezhalen    | successor, descendant                                                              | person + after           |
|       | mezhanon    | predecessor, ancestor                                                              | person + before          |
|       | menen'nin   | peer, equal, brethren, comrade, friend, fellow, colleague, acquaintance, associate | person + equal + rank    |
|       | me-methieen | leader, commander, chief                                                           | person + control         |
|       | me-ton'va   | farmer                                                                             | person + hoe             |
|       | me-gaga     | animal farmer                                                                      | person + animals         |
|       | mefin       | archer, hunter                                                                     | person + bow             |
|       | meksin      | swordsman                                                                          | person + sword           |
|       | meksen'hin  | hermit, hikikomori, lone person                                                    | person + secluded        |
|       | meten       | worker, employee                                                                   | person + service         |
|       | daten       | male worker                                                                        | man +  service           |
|       | buten       | female worker                                                                      | woman + service          |
|       | daten'mon   | butler                                                                             | male worker + domestic   |
|       | buten'mon   | maid                                                                               | female worker + domestic |
|       | mekon'ba    | merchant, seller, shopkeeper, clerk, salesperson                                   | person + buyable goods   |
|       | merogogun   | landlord                                                                           | person + owning land     |
## Unclarity

| glyph | sound          | meaning              | combo                         |
| ----- | -------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------- |
|       | shikon         | what                 | what + thing                  |
|       | kon'shi        | something            | thing + what                  |
|       | shime          | who                  | what + person                 |
|       | meshi          | someone              | person + what                 |
|       | shithaahya(un) | why, for what reason | what + intention + [context]  |
|       | thaahyashi(un) | for some reason      | intention + what + \[context] |
|       | shiho(un)      | how                  | what + way + [context]        |
|       | hoshi(un)      | somehow              | way + what + \[context]       |
|       | shigu(dun)     | where                | what + place + [at]           |
|       | gushi(dun)     | somewhere            | place + what + \[at]          |
|       | shizha(un)     | when                 | what + time + [context]       |
|       | zhashi(un)     | sometime             | time + what + \[context]      |
|       | shini(pi)      | how many, how much   | what + number + [of]          |
|       | nishi(pi)      | some (amount) of     | number + what + \[of]         |
|       | shiee          | which                | what + choices                |
|       | eeshi          | whichever            | choices + what                |
|       | kome           | everyone             | all + person                  |
|       | kokon          | everything           | all + thing                   |
|       | kogu(dun)      | everywhere           | all + place + \[at]           |
|       | kozha(un)      | always / every time  | all + time + \[context]       |
|       | ksome          | noone                | no + person                   |
|       | ksokon         | nothing              | no + thing                    |
|       | ksogu(dun)     | nowhere              | no + place + \[at]            |
|       | ksozha(un)     | never                | no + time + \[context]        |
|       | ksoee          | none / neither       | no + choices                  |
## Grammar

| glyph                    | sound          | meaning                                                                                                         | combo                      |
| ------------------------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
|                          | -wuten'un      | using, making use of                                                                                            |                            |
|                          | un'nen         | like, as, resembling                                                                                            | (context) + like           |
|                          | un'shi         | (question marker; makes the preceding sentence/clause a question)<br><br>*Works the same as Japanese "desuka?"* | (context) + what           |
|                          | un'wa          | (turns the preceding clause into the subject), e.g. ...ing ... is                                               | (context) + (subj)         |
|                          | un'wu          | (makes the preceding clause an object)                                                                          | (context) + (obj)          |
|                          | pethuwa        | (relative self-agent clause), that, which, who ...s oneself<br><br>*(s.agt) pethuwa (vrb) un'wa ...*            | (pe) + (self-agent)        |
|                          | pethu          | (relative agent clause), causative that, which, who<br><br>*(agt) pethu (subj) wa \[(obj) wu] (vrb) un'wa ...*  | (pe) + (agent)             |
|                          | pewa           | (relative subject clause), that, which, who<br><br>*(subj) pewa \[(obj) wu] (vrb) un'wa ...*                    | (pe) + (subj)              |
|                          | pewu           | (relative object clause), that/which/who is -ed<br><br>*(obj) pewu \[(agt) thu] \[(subj) wa] (vrb) un'wa ...*   | (pe) + (obj)               |
|                          | thowu          | (makes the preceding quote an object), e.g. to think that "..."                                                 | (quote) + (obj)            |
|                          | thu'wa         | (self-agent marker)                                                                                             | (agent) + (subject)        |
|                          | methi-         | (general causative noun)                                                                                        | person + because           |
|                          | yin'thi-       | auto-, self- (general causative noun)                                                                           | self + because             |
|                          | -en'kso        | (negative verb)                                                                                                 | (vrb) + not                |
|                          | -en'ksokon     | (neg. verbal noun form)                                                                                         | (vrb) + not + thing        |
